name: Quantoz PLNQ
who_can_redeem: Eligible holders have a par-redemption right against Quantoz Payments B.V. Operational access is subject to onboarding, current terms, and supported redemption channels.
redemption_region_notes: The legal redemption right is recorded separately from direct operational channel availability, customer eligibility, and jurisdiction-specific onboarding.
redemption_notes: Quantoz materials describe PLNQ as a one-to-one redeemable MiCAR electronic-money token backed under the issuer's safeguarded reserve policy.
summary: Polish-zloty-referenced electronic-money token issued by Quantoz Payments B.V., launched in April 2026 with verified Ethereum issuance and an issuer policy of safeguarded cash and government-bond reserves.
notes: PR #467 complete-record promotion. Token-specific reserve allocations, operational redemption terms, distribution inventory, and future non-Ethereum deployments remain explicit known unknowns.
